source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.1, data build 995, released 2026-10-16

data.summary:
You can re-roll the [Charge rolls](vsdata:core-rule/charge-step) of your **ADEPTUS CUSTODES** units.

**Favoured Ka'tah: Dacatarai**: as an extra effect of [Dacatarai](vsdata:ability/adeptus-custodes.martial-katah), whenever an enemy unit in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of the unit piles in or consolidates, it moves 2" less.

additionalEffect.trigger: engaged enemy unit's pile-in or consolidation move
additionalEffect.durationBasis: Core Rules 01.02.02: an effect with no stated duration lasts only for the phase in which it was applied.
